index.title: Game operations
index.intro: A game operation is the association leagues are played under. The assigned state association decides which clubs it is responsible for: responsibility always sits with the game operation at the root of an association tree, never with one at a subordinate association.

edit.shortNameHint: Shown in league lists and schedules.
edit.pathLabel: Path of the public association page
edit.pathHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only. Leave empty to derive the path from the short name.
edit.stateAssociationHint: Associations that already have a game operation are not offered: a state association has at most one.
edit.noStateAssociationWarning: Without a state association this game operation is not responsible for any club.
edit.nationalHint: Raises this game operation's SBK, RSK and assigner roles to all associations. Set deliberately: those roles then see the data of every state association.
edit.dependencyBlocked: While any of these remain, the game operation cannot be deleted. Move them first, then delete.
edit.dependencyFree: Nothing is attached any more, the game operation can be deleted.
edit.bannerAlt: Advertising banner of the game operation

notifications.bannerTypeError: Only JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG are allowed.
notifications.bannerSizeError: The banner may be at most 2 MB.
